instruction: An intimate studio portrait photograph with a soft and peaceful mood, captured in a close-up shot at eye-level against a plain, neutral beige backdrop. On the left, the woman with brown hair and bangs (R2) stands in profile facing right in a light beige bra, smiling with her eyes closed. On the right, the woman with voluminous curly dark hair (R1) stands facing left in a light gray tank top, also smiling with her eyes closed. The woman with curly hair (R1) wraps her arms around the other woman's (R2) waist from behind, and they gently lean their heads together. The scene is illuminated by soft, warm studio lighting, highlighting their serene expressions and natural skin tones.
